summary_en: FY3/27 dividend increased to ¥120/share (¥110 ordinary + ¥10 80th anniversary commemorative) vs ¥100 in FY3/26. Ordinary dividend raised ¥10. Mid-term dividend ¥65/share (¥55 ordinary + ¥10 commemorative); year-end dividend ¥55/share. Payout ratio target 40% basis; implied ratio ~47% on consolidated EPS ¥256.18. Company reached 80th anniversary January 2026.
title_en: Notice on Publication of Consolidated Business Forecast and Dividend Forecast (including 80th Anniversary Commemorative Dividend) for FY3/27
translation_en_brief: Gun Ei Chemical Industry announced FY3/27 (year ending March 31, 2027) dividend forecast. Annual dividend is set at ¥120 per share, comprising ¥110 ordinary dividend and ¥10 commemorative dividend, up from ¥100 in the prior year. The ordinary component has been raised by ¥10 per share. Dividend will be paid in two instalments: mid-term dividend of ¥65 per share (¥55 ordinary + ¥10 commemorative) and year-end dividend of ¥55 per share. The company stated that it targets a payout ratio of approximately 40% as a guideline for stable dividends. The ¥10 commemorative dividend is to mark the company's 80th anniversary, which was reached in January 2026. On the same date (July 30, 2026), the company also disclosed consolidated business forecast for FY3/27 showing consolidated net profit attributable to parent of ¥1,700 million (EPS ¥256.18), implying a payout ratio of approximately 47%.
